items.title: TotalEnergies eyes new exploration in Norway, CEO says
items.author: Nerijus Adomaitis, America Hernandez
items.creator: Nerijus Adomaitis, America Hernandez
items.summary: French oil major TotalEnergies will appoint a new exploration manager in Stavanger, Norway, to examine new projects in the country, its CEO said on Norwegian television on Monday.
items.body:
French oil major TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) will appoint a new exploration manager in Stavanger, Norway, to examine new projects in the country, its CEO said on Norwegian television on Monday.
"The Norwegian continental shelf is a very prolific basin, we see it as having potential for the future," Patrick Pouyanne said on the sidelines of the ONS energy conference in Stavanger.
Pouyanne described Norway as the natural energy supplier for Europe, where TotalEnergies hopes to expand its market share as European Union countries seek resources closer to home in light of disruptions in the Middle East due to the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran .
Following Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, Norway became [USN:L1N44L06P TEXT:"Europe's largest supplier"] of natural gas, meeting around 30% of the gas demand of the European Union and Britain.
"We spend $1 billion per year in exploration around the world, and it's one of the seven countries where we have decided to make a special effort ... If the geology is good, we'll allocate the capital," Pouyanne said.
TotalEnergies currently produces 220,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day in the country, or about 10% of its overall production, making it Norway's fourth-largest producer when excluding the state-owned Petoro.
The French company holds the largest amount of regasification capacity in Europe to import liquefied natural gas, and is the largest purchaser of U.S. LNG.
"Because I believe politically it will be difficult to see Russian gas coming back to Europe, it's a natural new market that we want to develop... either with Norwegian gas or LNG," Pouyanne said.

items.title: England drop Carse after investigation into club incident
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday.
items.body:
England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday.
"Following a referral from the ECB, the Cricket Regulator has confirmed that they will investigate events on Saturday night in Derby," the ECB said in a statement.
"Brydon Carse will no longer be available for selection for the second men's test while this investigation is ongoing and the full facts are obtained."
Carse, who did not play in the opening test victory at Headingley, will be replaced by Sonny Baker.
Videos circulated on social media appearing to show the 31-year-old Durham bowler in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers outside a venue. According to reports, Carse was not arrested and no charges were brought.
It has been a busy summer for England's Cricket Regulator, the body set up to investigate matters where there is an allegation of a breach of the ECB's code of conduct.
In June it concluded an investigation into former test captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Gus Atkinson after a nightclub incident following the first test against New Zealand.
Both were left out of the second test before the Regulator ruled that there was insufficient evidence to establish that any regulatory breach occurred.
The latest investigation comes five days after England's returning test captain Joe Root spoke of the players being "really good role models and human beings" following a series of incidents and accusations of a drinking culture.
Controversy has followed England around in recent times with off-field issues during last winter’s tours, including Harry Brook being fined £30,000 ($41,000) following an altercation in Wellington as well as reports of drinking during a mid-Ashes series trip to Noosa.
Stokes retired from international cricket after returning for the third test against New Zealand and Brendon McCullum was sacked as test coach.

items.title: Mexico president says Sinaloa governor's brief return to office was 'not appropriate'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha to return to his post after accusations of drug trafficking by the United States.
items.body:
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha to return to his post after accusations of drug trafficking by the United States.
Rocha, 77, a member of the ruling Morena party, dramatically [USN:L1N44I0K2 TEXT:"returned to office"] on Friday but [USN:L1N44K005 TEXT:"backtracked"] on Saturday following sharp criticism from Sheinbaum and other members of Morena.
"I had no prior knowledge that he wanted to return," Sheinbaum said at her daily morning press conference on Monday, adding that the Sinaloa state congress is expected to appoint an interim governor.
In April, U.S. prosecutors charged Rocha with conspiring with the Sinaloa Cartel to traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for bribes and political support.
Rocha has denied the charges, calling them a politically motivated attack.
Sheinbaum previously questioned the U.S. evidence against Rocha, but his brief return to office exposed tensions within the ruling party over the high-profile cartel allegations.

items.title: Seahawks lose rookie S Bud Clark to broken ankle
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Seahawks rookie safety Bud Clark will be out "multiple months" with a broken right ankle sustained in Sunday night's preseason loss at Tennessee.
items.body:
Seahawks rookie safety Bud Clark will be out "multiple months" with a broken right ankle sustained in Sunday night's preseason loss at Tennessee.
Seattle coach Mike Macdonald confirmed the extent of injury after the 19-16 defeat in Nashville. Clark, drafted by the reigning Super Bowl champions in the second round, was injured on the team's first defensive play and left the field on a cart with his leg in an air cast.
Reserve offensive lineman Mason Richman also sustained a long-term injury. The second-year guard walked off the field without assistance after getting hurt on the opening drive.
"Two guys that we love, that play our style of ball, that are our types of guys, teammates love them, great teammates, great guys, great football players, they have great futures," Macdonald said. "It's a heartbreaker, honestly. We had three heartbreakers this week, which is tough."
The Seahawks lost wideout Jake Bobo to a season-ending knee injury during Friday's joint practice with the Titans.
Clark, 24, was the 64th overall pick in the 2026 draft out of TCU, where he recorded 15 interceptions in 61 games.
Richman, 24, was drafted in the seventh round in 2025 out of Iowa. He appeared in two games for Seattle as a rookie, with 11 of his 12 snaps coming on special teams.
--Field Level Media

items.title: フーシ派、サウジのヤンブー沖で船舶攻撃と発表　国営海運バハリも被弾確認
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２４日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海沿岸にあるヤンブー港沖で船舶を攻撃したと発表した。同派の軍事報道官ヤヒヤ・サリー氏がテレビ演説で明らかにした。

サウジアラビアの国営海運会社バハリも同日、自社の船舶「アムザン」が紅海で攻撃を受けたと声明で明らかにした。

これに先立ち、英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、ヤンブーの西方６３カイリの海域でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと発表。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、乗組員全員の安全が確認されており、環境への影響も報告されていないという。

ヤンブーはサウジの主要な紅海沿岸の石油積み出し港で、１日あたり数百万バレルの石油が積み出されている。また、イランが封鎖しているホルムズ海峡を迂回するサウジ産原油の主要な輸出ルートとなっている。

items.title: Supermaxing prisons protected by minimum security
items.author: Jeffrey Goldfarb
items.creator: Jeffrey Goldfarb
items.summary: Under President Trump, shares of detention-center operators GEO and CoreCivic, worth $8 bln, have outpaced Nvidia, Exxon, Lockheed and more. The industry is benefiting from an immigrant crackdown even as crime rates fall. It’s a perverse business model that deserves a fresh look.
items.body:
Prisons got bailed out. Despite a steady decline in U.S. crime, the rise of punitive immigration enforcement has turbocharged detention centers. President Donald Trump may be good for business, but it's probably unsustainable and raises fresh concerns about perverse financial incentives at privatized for-profit penitentiaries.
When Trump secured his return to the White House, investors spotted fresh opportunities. Campaign promises indicated there was money to be made in backing domestic manufacturers, banks, cryptocurrencies, dietary supplements, defense contractors and oil producers. No inference was more profitable than one made from vows of mass deportation.
GEO (GEO.N) and CoreCivic (CXW.N) together oversee approximately 165 correctional facilities, with space for roughly 160,000 inmates. GEO’s shares have soared about 130% since November 2024 while CoreCivic’s are up nearly 160%, trouncing the benchmark S&P 500 Index (.SPX) and individual stocks in industries seen benefiting under Trump.
Although violent crime has been falling for years and the murder rate dropped to its lowest in seven decades, the enlarged and emboldened Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency is keeping wardens busy. Between 2016 and 2024, CoreCivic and GEO grew revenue by about 1% annually. For 2026, GEO’s top line is forecast to increase 24% from two years ago, hitting $3 billion, while CoreCivic’s is on track to jump 38%, according to Visible Alpha.
Just last month, GEO unveiled two new ICE contracts for $165 million a year while boss George Zoley said the company is in talks to sell some facilities to the agency. CoreCivic has offloaded four sites to the U.S. government for $2.2 billion, providing funds to possibly pay down debt or buy back stock.
The activity links to a president fixated on detaining and expelling immigrants. Because it's hurting the economy, his successors are likely to curb the extraordinary aggression. Prison operators are also attracting more unwanted attention. Immigrant fatalities in GEO’s Newark lockup prompted New Jersey to open a civil rights investigation and to sue the company for blocking state health inspectors. After Kansas lawmakers fought to impose restrictions on one location, CoreCivic sold it to the U.S. government.
Alleged mistreatment of incarcerated immigrants has revived widespread protests that amplify the risks for GEO and CoreCivic. Both say they prioritize prisoner well-being. Under President Barack Obama, the Justice Department sought to end its use of privately operated facilities. One 2016 study found that outsourcing detention costs less, but the administration argued it is neither safer nor cheaper than federally managed facilities. With both enterprises already trading at premiums to their 10-year average forward EBITDA multiples, shareholders are already sitting in minimum-security positions.
Follow Jeffrey Goldfarb on X and Linkedin .
Prison operator GEO said on August 6 that its second-quarter net income increased 63%, to $47.5 million, from a year earlier, on a 15% rise in revenue, thanks to lower labor costs and the record amount of new business it secured in 2025.
The company also increased its financial guidance for the rest of 2026, but noted it does not include new contracts signed in July with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement for facilities due to be active by the end of the year.
An immigrant who was being detained at the company's Delaney Hall detention center in Newark died on August 12. He is the third immigrant fatality at the facility since it reopened in May 2025.
New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport said on August 7 that she had opened a civil rights investigation into Delaney Hall. She sued GEO in June, alleging it refused full access to state health inspectors.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'S&P 500 e il Nasdaq, fortemente esposto ai titoli tech, perdono terreno mentre gli investitori valutano le potenziali ripercussioni dell'annuncio da parte degli Stati Uniti di un "D-Day economico" contro l'Iran, in attesa dei risultati del colosso dell'intelligenza artificiale NVIDIA e di un importante dato sull'inflazione atteso questa settimana.
items.body:
L'S&P 500 e il Nasdaq, fortemente esposto ai titoli tech, perdono terreno mentre gli investitori valutano le potenziali ripercussioni dell'annuncio da parte degli Stati Uniti di un "D-Day economico" contro l'Iran, in attesa dei risultati del colosso dell'intelligenza artificiale NVIDIA e di un importante dato sull'inflazione atteso questa settimana.
** L’andamento dei titoli delle megacap è contrastante. Mentre APPLE (AAPL.O) e AMAZON.COM (AMZN.O) guadagnano l’1% ciascuna, NVIDIA cede il 2,36%.
** Il settore Information Technology dell'S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) , in calo dell'1,6%, guida le perdite settoriali. Anche il comparto healthcare (.SPXHC) , tra le scelte preferite dagli investitori in cerca di diversificazione oltre l'IA, registra un calo dello 0,57%.
** Cedono terreno anche la maggior parte dei produttori di chip. MARVELL TECHNOLOGY (MRVL.O) e MICRON TECHNOLOGY (MU.O) scivolano di oltre il 6% e SANDISK (SNDK.O) del 9,3%.
** ALIBABA (9988.HK) , perde l’1,24% dopo che il gigante cinese dell’e-commerce ha lanciato un’offerta di vendita di azioni da 10,2 miliardi di dollari per finanziare i propri progetti nel campo dell'IA.
** Alle 16.35, l'S&P 500 (.SPX) perde lo 0,29%, il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cede lo 0,74%, mentre il Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) sale dello 0,31%.
** Gli operatori seguiranno inoltre i dati Pce sulle spese per i consumi personali, l'indicatore sull'inflazione preferito dalla Fed, in uscita mercoledì, per valutare in che misura il conflitto con l'Iran stia influenzando le condizioni economiche generali.
items.raw_description: L'S&P 500 e il Nasdaq, fortemente esposto ai titoli tech, perdono terreno mentre gli investitori valutano le potenziali ripercussioni dell'annuncio da parte degli Stati Uniti di un "D-Day economico" contro l'Iran, in attesa dei risultati del colosso dell'intelligenza artificiale NVIDIA e di un importante dato sull'inflazione atteso questa settimana.

items.title: Former world champion Dott convicted of historical sexual abuse
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
items.body:
Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010.
The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals.
He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month.
"Dott is a dangerous individual and I hope this conviction provides some measure of comfort to those impacted by his crimes," Detective Inspector Gary Smillie from Police Scotland told reporters.
Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010.
He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

items.title: Equinor, Aker BP e Vaar puntano a grandi scoperte di petrolio e gas in Norvegia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Equinor , Aker BP e Vaar Energi , controllata Eni hanno annunciato una collaborazione per trivellare aree finora poco esplorate della piattaforma continentale norvegese, puntando a scoprire nuovi giacimenti di petrolio e gas significativi dopo anni caratterizzati da ritrovamenti di dimensioni più contenute.
items.body:
Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) e Vaar Energi (VAR.OL) , controllata Eni (ENI.MI) hanno annunciato una collaborazione per trivellare aree finora poco esplorate della piattaforma continentale norvegese, puntando a scoprire nuovi giacimenti di petrolio e gas significativi dopo anni caratterizzati da ritrovamenti di dimensioni più contenute.
Operare in zone poco battute o del tutto inesplorate comporta costi più elevati e un rischio maggiore di pozzi a secco rispetto alle aree mature, ma può anche portare a scoperte più consistenti.
"Unendo le forze miglioreremo il portafoglio esplorativo riducendo al contempo il rischio", ha detto Kjetil Hove, responsabile delle operazioni norvegesi di Equinor, in una conferenza stampa congiunta.
Le tre società uniranno competenze, dati, tecnologia e capacità esplorative per perseguire opportunità selezionate ad alto potenziale, hanno aggiunto.
Negli ultimi anni, la maggior parte delle attività di perforazione in Norvegia si è concentrata sulle aree limitrofe ai giacimenti esistenti, portando a una serie di scoperte di minore entità che sono state messe rapidamente in produzione.
"L'esplorazione di prossimità rimane fondamentale, ma dobbiamo anche puntare su opportunità di maggiore portata per sostenere l'attività e la creazione di valore oltre il 2035", ha aggiunto Hove.
Le proiezioni governative indicano un calo drastico della produzione norvegese nel prossimo decennio in assenza di nuove scoperte rilevanti.
Nei prossimi quattro o cinque anni, le tre società intendono sviluppare un portafoglio di circa 20-25 opportunità, con l'ambizione di perforare circa cinque pozzi ad alto impatto all'anno.
Dal 2028, il costo annuale complessivo delle trivellazioni è stimato intorno ai 750 milioni di dollari, ripartiti in parti uguali tra i tre partner.
Le prime operazioni si concentreranno prevalentemente a Haltenbanken, nel Mare di Norvegia, con possibile estensione all'intera piattaforma continentale, ha detto Hove.
La Norvegia, primo produttore europeo di petrolio e gas, continua a incentivare le trivellazioni nella speranza di prolungare la vita del proprio settore energetico per i prossimi decenni, nonostante le preoccupazioni degli ambientalisti sull'impatto climatico.

items.title: Accounting at Guggenheim unit was 'appropriate', executive tells Bloomberg News
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Guggenheim Partners believes the accounting treatment at one of its units being probed by U.S. regulators was "appropriate", a senior executive of the firm's investment management arm told Bloomberg News on Monday.
items.body:
Guggenheim Partners believes the accounting treatment at one of its units being probed by U.S. regulators was "appropriate", a senior executive of the firm's investment management arm told Bloomberg News on Monday.
"We have been very open with regulators and very cooperative in their investigation and we will continue to do so. We’ve engaged with our auditors and we feel that the accounting treatment was appropriate," Anne Walsh, chief investment officer of Guggenheim Partners Investment Management, said in an interview with Bloomberg.
Bloomberg had previously reported that accounting at Guggenheim Private Investments (GPI) was the focus of a whistleblower report early last year, which helped prompt a federal criminal investigation.
Federal prosecutors with the U.S. attorney's office in Manhattan and investigators from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's New York office are probing billionaire Mark Walter's firm Guggenheim, a person with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
Guggenheim is not facing any inquiries into its investment or trade allocation processes as part of the probe, Walsh told Bloomberg in the interview.
Walter's sprawling empire has come under the scanner as U.S. prosecutors investigate his insurance companies, [USN:L4N44F0SP TEXT:"Delaware Life Insurance Company"] and Clear Spring Life and Annuity Company, over the classification of some investments in affiliated entities.
The billionaire, 66, is the CEO of Guggenheim Partners, the parent company of Guggenheim Securities, the firm's brokerage, and Guggenheim Investments, its money manager.
Elsewhere, Walter's holding company, TWG Global, on Monday announced David Markowitz as its new chief legal officer. The industry veteran joins the firm after more than 15 years in senior legal roles at Wall Street giant Goldman Sachs (GS.N) .

items.summary: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
items.body:
Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
16.05 - La presidente del Consiglio Giorgia Meloni ha ribadito oggi il sostegno dell'Italia alla sovranità e all'integrità territoriale dell'Ucraina, intervenendo in videocollegamento alla riunione dei leader della Coalizione dei volenterosi, nel giorno dell'anniversario dell'indipendenza del Paese.
Durante il vertice, i leader hanno concordato sulla necessità di rafforzare il regime sanzionatorio contro Mosca e contrastarne l'elusione.
Meloni, come si legge in una nota di Palazzo Chigi, ha riaffermato inoltre l'impegno di Roma a lavorare con i partner internazionali per favorire un percorso negoziale verso una pace "giusta e duratura". La premier ha confermato anche l'impegno italiano sul fronte umanitario in vista dell'inverno, annunciando l'invio di ulteriori generatori per sostenere la popolazione ucraina e la rete energetica.
13.05 - L’Ucraina vuole la pace ma non intende arrendersi alla Russia a qualsiasi prezzo.
Lo ha affermato lunedì il presidente Volodymyr Zelensky in un discorso combattivo in occasione delle celebrazioni per la giornata dell’Indipendenza, a cui hanno partecipato a Kiev anche leader stranieri.
Il primo ministro britannico Andy Burnham e il presidente del Consiglio europeo Antonio Costa erano presenti alle celebrazioni per il 35° anniversario della separazione dell’Ucraina dall’Unione Sovietica.

items.title: Exportações semanais de grãos da Ucrânia caíram 11,4%, diz consultoria
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As exportações semanais dos principais grãos da Ucrânia caíram 11,4% no período de 13 a 19 de agosto, para 188.200 toneladas métricas, devido ao bloqueio dos portos do Mar Negro, informou nesta segunda-feira a consultoria agrícola APK-Inform.
items.body:
As exportações semanais dos principais grãos da Ucrânia caíram 11,4% no período de 13 a 19 de agosto, para 188.200 toneladas métricas, devido ao bloqueio dos portos do Mar Negro, informou nesta segunda-feira a consultoria agrícola APK-Inform.
Os portos marítimos ucranianos no complexo portuário de Odessa interromperam efetivamente suas operações no final de julho devido a ataques russos com drones e mísseis contra terminais e embarcações.
A APK-Inform informou que as exportações incluíram 119.300 toneladas de trigo, 51.900 toneladas de milho e 17.100 toneladas de cevada.
"O comércio das principais culturas de grãos permanecerá moderado devido aos riscos de segurança nos portos do Mar Negro e às rotas de exportação limitadas", afirmou a consultoria em um relatório.
O Ministério da Agricultura do país informou na semana passada que as exportações de grãos ucranianos haviam caído quase 69% até o momento em agosto, em comparação com o mesmo período do ano anterior.
A Ucrânia e a Rússia lançaram ataques mais amplos contra as instalações logísticas uma da outra, com armazéns de ambos os lados sofrendo ataques intensos nos últimos meses.

items.title: Shein lancia Ipo fino a 27 mld dlr a Hong Kong
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shein punta a raccogliere fino a 1,8 miliardi di dollari con un'Ipo a Hong Kong che valuta il retailer di fast fashion a circa il 70% in meno rispetto alla cifra raggiunta in occasione di un round di finanziamenti quattro anni fa, con prospettive di crescita più moderate destinate a pesare sulla domanda degli investitori.
items.body:
Shein punta a raccogliere fino a 1,8 miliardi di dollari con un'Ipo a Hong Kong che valuta il retailer di fast fashion a circa il 70% in meno rispetto alla cifra raggiunta in occasione di un round di finanziamenti quattro anni fa, con prospettive di crescita più moderate destinate a pesare sulla domanda degli investitori.
Il tanto atteso debutto a Hong Kong arriva dopo che Shein, nota per vendere abiti a 5 dollari e jeans a 10 dollari in 160 Paesi, ha abbandonato negli ultimi quattro anni i piani di quotazione a New York e a Londra.
La società ha avviato oggi la procedura per la vendita di 280 milioni di azioni a un prezzo compreso tra 47,60 e 49,50 HK$ per azione, secondo quanto emerge dai documenti depositati, raccogliendo fino a 13,86 miliardi di HK$ (1,77 miliardi di dollari) e raggiungendo una valutazione di quasi 27 miliardi di dollari nella fascia alta dell'intervallo.
Il ridimensionamento della valutazione arriva in un momento in cui dazi, crescita della concorrenza e aumento dei costi pesano sulle prospettive di crescita della società.
Nel 2023 e nell'aprile 2024 Shein era stata valutata 64 miliardi di dollari. La scorsa settimana Reuters aveva riportato in esclusiva che l'Ipo avrebbe valutato l'azienda a circa un quarto dei 100 miliardi di dollari raggiunti nel 2022.
Anche dopo aver ridotto drasticamente la valutazione, gli analisti avvertono che i crescenti venti contrari nei suoi mercati principali, Stati Uniti ed Europa, continueranno a pesare sulla raccolta di fondi dell'azienda.
(1 dollaro = 7,8382 dollari di Hong Kong)

items.title: Surge in bond yields is a result of "Trump's war", German minister says
items.author: Maria Martinez
items.creator: Maria Martinez
items.summary: The recent surge in bond yields is a result of United States President "Donald Trump's war in Iran", German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Monday at a press conference in Schaan, Liechtenstein.
items.body:
The recent [USN:L4N44H0QY TEXT:"surge in bond yields"] is a result of United States President "Donald Trump's war in Iran", German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Monday at a press conference in Schaan, Liechtenstein.
"The rise in interest rates in recent days and weeks is the result of global uncertainty triggered by Donald Trump's war in Iran," he said speaking alongside the finance ministers of other German-speaking countries.
Germany's 30-year government bond yield hit its highest since 2011 at 3.79% last week, with inflation fears tied to the Iran war adding to the selloff in bonds.
Germany, the euro zone's benchmark issuer, sold a bond at that maturity a day earlier with the highest yield in 15 years.
Washington was set to [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"warn countries"] to cut ties with Iran or risk their businesses being cut off from the dollar-based financial system, a source told Reuters on Monday.
The U.S. and Iran have not conducted air strikes on each other's militaries for weeks, but their last official face-to-face talks to end the six-month-old conflict took place in June and strikes on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz have continued.

items.title: Astros and GM Dana Brown agree to part ways
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Houston Astros and general manager Dana Brown mutually agreed to part ways on Monday.
items.body:
The Houston Astros and general manager Dana Brown mutually agreed to part ways on Monday.
Brown, 59, had held the post since January 2023 and his contract was set to expire at the end of this season.
The Astros (65-66) have lost six of their last eight games and entered Monday tied atop the American League West with the Texas Rangers.
"Over the past four seasons, Dana has helped our organization win two division titles and has led our baseball front office through key scouting, draft and development efforts," team owner and chairman Jim Crane said in a news release. "On behalf of the Astros, I want to thank him for his commitment, energy, and contributions to our organization. We wish he and his family the best."
The Astros said Brown's responsibilities will be transitioned to the assistant general managers Charles Cook, Gavin Dickey and Connor Huff, and to senior advisor Jeff Bagwell. Crane will oversee baseball operations through the transition period.
"I want to thank Jim Crane for the opportunity to serve in my first role as an MLB general manager," Brown said. "The Astros organization and the fans have welcomed me and my family, and I am grateful to have called Houston home for the past four seasons. I wish the organization well and I look forward to the future as I continue my 36-plus years in professional baseball."
The Astros missed the playoffs last season for the first time since 2016. They reached the American League Championship Series in Brown's first season in 2023, losing to the Rangers in seven games, and were swept in the wild-card round by the Detroit Tigers in 2024.
The signature move of Brown's tenure was a December 2024 trade that sent All-Star outfielder Kyle Tucker to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for infielder Isaac Paredes, right-hander Hayden Wesneski and outfielder Cam Smith.
Brown worked in the front offices and scouting departments of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Montreal Expos/Washington Nationals, Toronto Blue Jays and Atlanta Braves before joining the Astros. In Houston, he replaced James Click, who departed just days after the Astros won the 2022 World Series.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Re-escalating trade war puts Canada's economic rebound at risk: economists
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Economists are warning that a re-escalation in the trade war with the United States puts Canada’s burgeoning economic recovery at risk.
items.body: OTTAWA — Economists are warning that a re-escalation in the trade war with the United States puts Canada’s burgeoning economic recovery at risk. The U.S. imposed 50 per cent tariffs on roughly $28 billion worth of Canadian goods over the weekend after trade talks fell apart. Bank of Montreal expects the new tariffs will carve half a percentage point off Canada’s economic growth as business investment and confidence take a hit. Prime Minister Mark Carney has pledged to retaliate with dollar-for-dollar tariffs starting Sept. 8, which economists warn could add to inflation in Canada. Bradley Saunders, North American economist at Capital Economics, says in a note to clients that the new tariffs push Canada closer to a recession, particularly if the United States ramps up attacks in response to Ottawa’s own retaliation. Economists also say the extent of the hit to the economy will depend on the degree of fiscal stimulus from Canadian governments in response to the new U.S. duties. --- Craig Lord, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 24, 2026.

items.summary: El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario de cambios operaba el lunes en su nivel mínimo histórico, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta.
items.body:
El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario de cambios operaba el lunes en su nivel mínimo histórico, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta.
Por su parte, los mercados de acciones y bonos del país sudamericano registraban mejoras luego de finalizar en baja la semana previa.
En el segmento mayorista , la moneda nacional, el peso, se depreciaba un 0,53% a 1.508 unidades por dólar, su nivel mínimo histórico, luego de cerrar la semana previa en 1.500 unidades en su punta vendedora.
"El dólar mayorista quebró la barrera de los 1.500 (pesos) porque contenerlo a medida que pasa el tiempo exige esfuerzos mayores en términos de comprar menos reservas y subir tasas", dijo a Reuters Roberto Gerreto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.
"Así, subas graduales del dólar van a permitir que no se atrase, facilitando la acumulación de reservas y no agregando estrés en las tasas. La clave será que no tenga ningún componente anunciado o sistemático, porque ello daría incentivos a dolarizar como ocurre cuando hay un 'crawling peg' formal", agregó.
El banco central argentino acumuló compras por 137 millones de dólares la semana previa.
"En lo que va de agosto las compras (del BCRA) acumulan 466 millones de dólares, un promedio de 33 millones de dólares diarios que profundiza la desaceleración frente a julio (103 millones diarios) y queda por debajo de junio (68 millones de dólares) y mayo (137 millones de dólares)", explicó el agente de compensación y liquidación Cohen.
El índice S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires mejoraba un 1,32% a las 1435 GMT, apoyada por el avance de acciones del rubro financiero. El Merval cayó un 1,2% la semana previa.
"Pese al freno del deterioro reciente, el mercado mantiene la cautela ante la duda de si este movimiento constituye una mejora de fondo o un mero rebote técnico", expresó la consultora Wise Capital.
En tanto, los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil mejoraban un 0,3% promedio tras finalizar con un retroceso de 1,8% la semana pasada. El riesgo país, elaborado por el banco JP. Morgan, retrocedía algunos escalones hasta los 500 puntos básicos.

items.title: 米国、対イラン追加制裁を発表へ－財務長官「経済的生命線全て断つ」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランに対する新たな経済制裁措置を発表する見通しだ。約6カ月に及ぶ戦争の終結を目指し、米政府は軍事攻撃の威嚇から、徹底した経済制裁による圧力強化へと軸足を移す。

ベッセント氏は予定している会見で、イランを一段と効果的に孤立させる計画の詳細を明らかにする。米国は数十年にわたり広範な対イラン制裁を科してきたが、今回さらに強化する。具体的な内容は不明だが、中国やトルコ、インドなどイランの主要貿易相手国の一部に影響が及ぶ可能性がある。

アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）は先週、イランとの経済関係を全て断絶したと発表。湾岸の米同盟国によるこうした動きが、ワシントンの戦略を後押ししている。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「世界は、イランが孤立するまで、この圧政政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断つことがわれわれの目的だと理解すべきだ」と述べた。

イラン経済は既に極めて厳しい状況にあり、米海軍による海上封鎖で重要な原油輸出が大幅に制限されている。

イランでは年間インフレ率が80％を超え、人口9000万人の国民への圧力が一段と強まっている。イラン通貨リアルは対ドルで過去最安値に沈む。トランプ米大統領が先週、イランへの経済圧力を強める計画を明らかにして以降、4.5％下落した。

イランはこれまでも制裁をしのいできた経緯があり、米国の今回の措置が新たな軍事攻撃を招く恐れもある。イランは、米国の制裁計画を支援する国には報復すると警告した。2月下旬の戦争開始以降、イランは湾岸の米同盟国に数千発のミサイルやドローンを撃ち込んでいる。

イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は23日夜、「米国によるイラン国民への経済戦争に参加したり、これを支援したりする国の行為を戦争行為とみなす」とXへの投稿で表明。

その上で、「ホルムズ海峡からも、ペルシャ湾のどこからも、原油は一滴たりとも輸出されなくなる」と述べた。

items.title: Two U.N. peacekeepers killed in ambush on patrol in South Sudan
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two U.N. peacekeepers were killed in an ambush while on a patrol in South Sudan's Jonglei state on Monday, the U.N. mission said in a statement.
items.body:
Two U.N. peacekeepers were killed in an ambush while on a patrol in South Sudan's Jonglei state on Monday, the U.N. mission said in a statement.
Seven others were injured when unidentified armed men attacked the patrol as it travelled to Pajut, the United Nations Mission in South Sudan said in a statement.
The wounded included three peacekeepers, two South Sudan National Police Service personnel and two civilian staff.
UNMISS said it deployed a Quick Reaction Force to secure the area and support the emergency response.
"Such deadly violence targeting UNMISS personnel who are serving to support peace in South Sudan is unacceptable," Anita Kiki Gbeho, the head of UNMISS, said.
The mission called for a prompt investigation and said attacks on U.N. peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law.
Attacks on U.N. personnel are rare but not unprecedented in South Sudan, where UNMISS patrols operate in volatile areas affected by intercommunal fighting, armed youth mobilisations and clashes involving government forces.

items.title: Sheinbaum era contraria a regreso de gobernador al cargo, tras cargos de narcotráfico de EEUU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, dijo el lunes que no estuvo de acuerdo con el regreso al cargo del gobernador del estado norteño Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, tras ser acusado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico.
items.body:
La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, dijo el lunes que no estuvo de acuerdo con el regreso al cargo del gobernador del estado norteño Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, tras ser acusado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico.
El viernes, Rocha [USN:L6N44I0WP TEXT:"retomó intempestivamente"] su puesto de gobernador, generando el rechazo del Gobierno y del partido gubernamental Morena. El sábado, tras un cuestionamiento de la propia mandataria, [USN:L6N44K00A TEXT:"solicitó una licencia"] temporal para separarse del cargo, como había hecho en mayo tras conocerse los señalamientos de Washington.
"Me enteré por la publicación del propio gobernador, no tuve ningún conocimiento previo de que él quisiera regresar a ejercer sus funciones (...) no me parecía pertinente", afirmó Sheinbaum en su conferencia de prensa diaria.
El lunes, el Congreso de Sinaloa deberá escoger al sucesor de Rocha.

items.title: Kenia detiene a cuatro personas por investigación sobre la muerte de 18 elefantes en Amboseli
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La policía detuvo a cuatro sospechosos en el marco de una investigación sobre la muerte de 18 elefantes en el ecosistema de Amboseli, en Kenia, donde las autoridades también incautaron diversas sustancias, entre ellas productos químicos, informó el Ministerio de Turismo y Vida Silvestre.
items.body:
La policía detuvo a cuatro sospechosos en el marco de una investigación sobre la muerte de 18 elefantes en el ecosistema de Amboseli, en Kenia, donde las autoridades también incautaron diversas sustancias, entre ellas productos químicos, informó el Ministerio de Turismo y Vida Silvestre.
Un portavoz del Servicio de Vida Silvestre de Kenia (KWS) declaró el lunes a Reuters que los cuatro han sido puestos en libertad bajo fianza.
Los resultados preliminares de laboratorio apuntan a la probable presencia de una sustancia tóxica, según indicó el ministerio en un comunicado publicado el sábado, aunque los primeros indicios sugerían un envenenamiento por cianuro debido a la ingestión de tomates contaminados con pesticidas procedentes de explotaciones agrícolas situadas en los alrededores del Parque Nacional de Amboseli.
Algunos expertos en fauna silvestre han expresado sus dudas sobre que los pesticidas agrícolas fueran los responsables de las muertes, alegando la ausencia de muertes registradas entre otros animales de la zona.
El ministerio indicó que los investigadores también estaban buscando a una quinta persona que se cree que dispone de información relevante para el caso. Un registro realizado en Tikondo, en el subcondado de Loitoktok, a unos 220 km al sureste de Nairobi, condujo al hallazgo de diversas sustancias, entre ellas productos químicos que se cree que proceden de un país vecino, según el comunicado.
El ministerio señaló que las detenciones y las sustancias incautadas no constituían por sí mismas una prueba de culpabilidad penal, y añadió que las investigaciones seguían en curso.
Las primeras 15 muertes de elefantes se registraron entre el 24 de junio y el 24 de julio, según el ministerio. En julio, el Servicio de Vida Silvestre de Kenia (KWS) indicó que las muertes se produjeron en el Parque Nacional de Amboseli, el Santuario de Kimana y la zona del rancho de Kuku, y que los animales mostraban síntomas como parálisis parcial antes de morir en el plazo de uno o dos días.
El ecosistema más amplio de Amboseli abarca el parque nacional y las tierras comunitarias circundantes en el sur de Kenia, cerca de la frontera con Tanzania, y proporciona hábitat y rutas de desplazamiento a los elefantes y otros animales salvajes a los pies del monte Kilimanjaro.
La zona tiene un historial de conflictos entre personas y fauna silvestre, ya que los elefantes se adentran más allá de las áreas protegidas hacia tierras comunitarias y agrícolas, pisoteando los cultivos y provocando el enfado de los agricultores.

items.title: Vladimir Putin offers to increase Russia's fertiliser exports to India
items.author: Archis Mohan
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said Moscow was prepared to increase fertiliser supplies to India, while noting that bilateral trade grew in the first half of 2026 ...
items.body: Moscow is willing to increase its fertiliser supplies to India’s agricultural sector, Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Monday during his meeting with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar.  The Russian President noted that bilateral trade between the two countries increased in the first half of 2026, after a decline in 2025. Jaishankar began his two-day official visit to Moscow on Sunday. He cochaired the 27th session of the India-Russia Inter-governmental Commission on trade, economic, scientific, technological and cultural cooperation, with Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov. India is keen to host Putin for the Brics summit on September 12 and 13 in New Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is also slated to meet the Russian president in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, during the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit on August 31 and September 1. During the meeting, Putin said Manturov and Jaishankar have been working on increasing bilateral trade between the two countries, and must have discussed the key issues during their meeting, which are many. “One of these issues – not just fuel – is the supply of mineralisers (fertilisers). We are doing everything we can to resolve the issue for Indian farmers, for agriculture; we are increasing these exports and are prepared to continue doing so,” Putin said, according to Russian news agency Interfax.  “I am pleased to note that our trade has increased this year. It declined slightly last year, but it is growing this year,” he said. Russia has emerged as India’s biggest supplier of fertilisers, especially urea, in recent years. India’s imports of fertilisers from Russia increased by almost 40 per cent in 2025.  During Putin’s visit to New Delhi in December 2025, the two sides welcomed “steps to ensure long-term supply of fertilisers to India and discussed the potential establishment of joint ventures in this area.” At the meeting, Jaishankar said the increase in India-Russia bilateral trade from $13 billion in 2021 to $60 billion in 2025 has widened the trade imbalance, which has increased from $6.6 billion to over $50 billion in Russia’s favour. “Addressing this imbalance today is one of our foremost priorities,” Jaishankar said. The external affairs minister said progress on market access, removal of tariff and non-tariff barriers, strengthening payment mechanisms and stronger business-to-business engagement would be critical to addressing the imbalance and achieving the shared objective of $100 billion in bilateral trade by 2030. Manturov said bilateral trade with India would increase after the free trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) takes effect. “The preparation (for the trade deal) is in the active phase, and it is important to maintain the strong momentum at negotiations,” he said. Manturov said Russia and India increased bilateral trade by 8 per cent in the first half of 2026, stressing the need to increase and diversify trade. He said trade in agricultural produce, machine-building goods, metallurgy and forest products is expanding as well as traditional supplies of fuel and mineral fertilisers from Russia. “Imports from India include pharmaceuticals, agricultural products, industrial raw materials, equipment and components and light industry goods,” he said. The two sides also discussed civil nuclear cooperation.

items.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq caen mientras tensiones con Irán ponen a prueba a los mercados
items.author: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.creator: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.summary: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendían el lunes, mientras los inversores sopesan las posibles repercusiones de la promesa de Estados Unidos de un "Día D económico" contra Irán, a la espera de los resultados del gigante de la inteligencia artificial Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación que se publicará esta semana.
items.body:
Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendían el lunes, mientras los inversores sopesan las posibles repercusiones de la promesa de Estados Unidos de un "Día D económico" contra Irán, a la espera de los resultados del gigante de la inteligencia artificial Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación que se publicará esta semana.
* A las 1345 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) ganaba 112,18 puntos, o un 0,21%, a 53.389,19 unidades; el S&P 500 (.SPX) bajaba 20,77 puntos, o un 0,27%, a 7.653,60 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) caía 164,51 puntos, o un 0,63%, a 26.015,94 unidades
* Estos movimientos marcan un comienzo moderado a una semana crucial que podría determinar si los mercados bursátiles son capaces de hacer caso omiso del recrudecimiento de la tensión en Oriente Medio y de las preocupaciones relacionadas con un mercado de bonos tenso, factores que han interrumpido su repunte.
* Estados Unidos dijo que podría imponer sanciones económicas a los socios comerciales de Irán, en lo que calificó como "la mayor ofensiva financiera de la historia". El secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, tiene previsto celebrar una rueda de prensa al respecto más tarde en el día.
* La preocupación por el aumento de los precios de la energía y el creciente endeudamiento público impulsó el rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro la semana pasada, y el retorno a 30 años alcanzó su máximo en 19 años antes de que el Tesoro anunciara medidas de apoyo.
* El aumento de los retornos afectó duramente a las acciones tecnológicas orientadas al crecimiento, lo que provocó que los tres índices principales de Wall Street registraran pérdidas la semana pasada.
* Se espera que los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia (NVDA.O) , la empresa más valiosa del mundo, sean otro catalizador clave para los mercados. Cualquier indicio de ralentización del crecimiento podría reavivar la preocupación sobre las valoraciones excesivas y hasta dónde podría llegar el impulso de la IA.
* La evolución de las firmas de megacapitalización era desigual en la sesión. Mientras Apple (AAPL.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) subían menos de un 1%, Nvidia perdía un 2,44%.

items.title: New Zealand's Mo’unga returns to stake World Cup claims
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Zealand flyhalf Richie Mo'unga will don an All Blacks jersey on Tuesday for the first time since the last World Cup final as he makes a bid for a place in the squad for next year’s global tournament.
items.body:
New Zealand flyhalf Richie Mo'unga will don an All Blacks jersey on Tuesday for the first time since the last World Cup final as he makes a bid for a place in the squad for next year’s global tournament.
Mo'unga will start against the Lions at Ellis Park as New Zealand play the last game against provincial opposition on their eight-match tour of South Africa.
The 32-year-old was called up as an injury replacement in an effort by new coach Dave Rennie to integrate him into the squad one year out from the 2027 World Cup in Australia.
"One reason for coming back was obviously to win a World Cup, but to not have any regrets of ‘geez, I wish I had given it another crack or maybe there was a bit more to give," Mo’unga told reporters on Monday.
"I’ve just come back really grateful. I knew I missed it, but coming back in, you realise this is a really special circle to be in. I’m just really savouring every moment and just not going to take these things for granted," he added.
The All Blacks have Ruben Love as first-choice flyhalf and unless there is an injury or major loss of form, there is little chance Mo'unga will play in the remaining three tests.
Mo’unga was unavailable for selection after three seasons with Toshiba Brave Lupus in Japan because the All Blacks have rules on only picking home-based players, but he returned to New Zealand in June and was included in an All Blacks training camp.
His first opportunity to play for Canterbury came after the tour party had departed for South Africa, but injury to Billy Proctor gave Rennie the chance to call up the skilful Mo’unga as a replacement
New Zealand lost the last World Cup final in Paris in 2023 by one point to South Africa but blitzed the Springboks 33-16 at Ellis Park on Saturday in the first of the four-test series dubbed "Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry".

items.title: Tarifa de energia de distribuidora do RS deve aumentar 22%, calcula Aneel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A tarifa de energia elétrica da distribuidora gaúcha CEEE Equatorial deve subir 22,31%, em média, este ano, puxada pela remuneração de investimentos realizados após as enchentes de 2024 no Estado, além da cobrança de valores que foram adiados para aliviar os consumidores na época.
items.body:
A tarifa de energia elétrica da distribuidora gaúcha CEEE Equatorial deve subir 22,31%, em média, este ano, puxada pela remuneração de investimentos realizados após as enchentes de 2024 no Estado, além da cobrança de valores que foram adiados para aliviar os consumidores na época.
O aumento tarifário de mais de 20% foi calculado pela agência reguladora Aneel e ainda passará por consulta e audiência pública, que foram aprovadas nesta segunda-feira pela diretoria do órgão.
Controlada pela Equatorial (EQTL3.SA) , a CEEE distribui energia na região metropolitana de Porto Alegre e outras regiões do Rio Grande do Sul, e passa neste ano por revisão tarifária, processo no qual a Aneel faz uma avaliação completa sobre investimentos realizados pela concessionária, custos e outros fatores associados às tarifas.
Pela proposta do regulador, os consumidores da CEEE conectados em alta tensão, como indústrias, teriam aumento tarifário médio de 15,88%, enquanto as residências perceberiam uma alta média de 24,38%.
O principal fator altista são os componentes financeiros, incluindo a cobrança de parte de um reajuste tarifário que foi postergado em 2024, para mitigar os impactos aos consumidores em meio às enchentes, e compensações pleiteadas pela distribuidora.
O aumento tarifário também reflete um aumento da base de remuneração regulatória (BRR) de ativos da distribuidora, após investimentos que foram feitos principalmente depois das enchentes, apontou a Aneel.
A proposta tarifária para a CEEE fica submetida à consulta pública entre 26 de agosto e 9 de outubro, com previsão de audiência pública da Aneel para discutir o tema presencialmente em Porto Alegre em 8 de outubro.
items.raw_description: A tarifa de energia elétrica da distribuidora gaúcha CEEE Equatorial deve subir 22,31%, em média, este ano, puxada pela remuneração de investimentos realizados após as enchentes de 2024 no Estado, além da cobrança de valores que foram adiados para aliviar os consumidores na época.

items.title: Video parece mostrar cómo 600 personas son secuestradas en ataque a una mezquita en Nigeria, dicen vecinos
items.author: Ahmed Kingimi, Hamza Ibrahim
items.creator: Ahmed Kingimi, Hamza Ibrahim
items.summary: Un grupo armado ha publicado un video en el que se ve a lo que, según los residentes, serían unas 600 mujeres, niños y personas mayores secuestradas en un ataque perpetrado la semana pasada contra una mezquita en el estado de Níger, situado en la zona centro-norte de Nigeria.
items.body:
Un grupo armado ha publicado un video en el que se ve a lo que, según los residentes, serían unas 600 mujeres, niños y personas mayores secuestradas en un ataque perpetrado la semana pasada contra una mezquita en el estado de Níger, situado en la zona centro-norte de Nigeria.
El video, publicado el domingo en Facebook y WhatsApp, mostraba a grandes grupos de personas sentadas en una zona boscosa rodeadas de hombres armados. Se oía llorar a varios niños de fondo.
Los secuestros masivos para obtener rescate se han convertido en algo habitual en algunas zonas del noroeste y centro-norte de Nigeria, donde bandas fuertemente armadas asaltan con frecuencia pueblos, colegios y carreteras, y retienen a los rehenes hasta que se pagan grandes sumas de dinero.
Los hombres armados se han ido expandiendo cada vez más hacia el sur, más allá de los focos de conflicto del norte.
"HEMOS IDENTIFICADO A NUESTROS ANCIANOS Y FAMILIARES" El video salió a la luz dos días después del último secuestro, cuando hombres armados atacaron a los fieles en la mezquita de la aldea de Dekara durante la oración del viernes, llevándose a varias personas en lo que, según los residentes, fueron redadas simultáneas en varias comunidades.
En el video, un hombre armado que habla en hausa se dirige a las familias de los secuestrados y les insta a identificar a sus familiares entre las personas que aparecen en las imágenes.
"Todos estos son de los de ustedes. Les mostramos este video para que identifiquen a los miembros de su familia, a sus padres, madres, hijos y familiares", dijo el hombre armado.
Reuters no ha podido verificar la fecha exacta ni el lugar donde se grabó el video. Sin embargo, no se ha encontrado ninguna versión anterior publicada en Internet antes del 23 de agosto de 2026.
Cuatro residentes afirmaron haber podido confirmar la identidad de algunas de las personas secuestradas.
"Las personas que aparecen en el video son de Dekara. He identificado a 13 personas que conozco", declaró Ibrahim Abubakar a Reuters.
Otro residente, Abdulmutallib Muqaddas Dindi, afirmó que las personas que aparecían en el video habían sido secuestradas durante las oraciones. "Hemos identificado a nuestros mayores y a nuestros familiares, y algunos de nosotros hemos visto a sus esposas e hijos en el video", afirmó.
La policía y las autoridades estatales no respondieron el lunes a las solicitudes de comentarios. La policía había confirmado anteriormente un ataque contra fieles en la zona, pero afirmó que no podía verificar el número de personas secuestradas.
El residente Jamilu Ibrahim hizo un llamado a las autoridades federales y estatales para que consigan la liberación de los rehenes, señalando el número de madres con bebés y niños que aparecían entre las personas que se veían en las imágenes.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nora Buli

[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Nora Buli

[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　２４日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２１日、戦略石油備蓄の追加放出については現時点で協議していないとロイターに述べた。

ビロル氏はノルウェーで開かれたエネルギー会議の合間に、ＩＥＡが戦略石油備蓄の２回目の放出について検討しているかとの質問に対し、「当面は検討していない」と言及。ＩＥＡは市場を「非常に注意深く」注視し続けており、３月に行った４億バレルの放出後も戦略備蓄の８０％が残っていると明らかにした。

天然ガスに関しては、透明性プラットフォーム「ＡＧＳＩ」のデータで欧州の現在のガス備蓄水準が約６２％にとどまっていることに懸念を表明。「備蓄は過去の平均を下回っており、われわれは依然として中東からのガス供給に期待している。同時に欧州はロシア産ガスの輸入停止を約束している」とし、「欧州に厳しい冬が訪れた場合、いくつかの課題に直面する可能性がある」と述べた。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）は１２月１日までに備蓄率を８０％まで引き上げることを目標としている。

items.title: Russia's Perm oil refinery halted operations after August 21 drone attack, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Perm oil refinery, Russia's seventh-largest oil processing plant by volumes, stopped operations following a Ukrainian drone attack, which caused fire and damage to technological units on August 21, two industry sources said on Monday.
items.body:
The Perm oil refinery, Russia's seventh-largest oil processing plant by volumes, stopped operations following a Ukrainian drone attack, which caused fire and damage to technological units on August 21, two industry sources said on Monday.
Ukraine has stepped up attacks on Russia's energy infrastructure, including oil refineries, in recent months to undermine Moscow's war efforts and cut its financial income.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Friday that Ukraine's military hit a Russian oil refinery in the city of Perm.
Numerous Russian regions have reported [USN:L1N44H0AG TEXT:"fuel shortages"] due to the strikes on the refineries and a robust seasonal demand.
Sources said that the primary CDU-4 unit, which accounts for almost 40% of the plant's capacity, was halted on August 21. It is able to process 14,000 metric tons of oil per day.
According to preliminary estimates, the repair works could take between one and two weeks.
Another primary refining unit, CDU-5, which accounts for 34% of the plant's capacity, has been idle since a July 29 [USN:L6N43W0QW TEXT:"drone attack"], according to the sources.
The plant also has two more crude distillation units, CDU-1 and CDU-2, each of which accounts for 14% of the plant's capacity.
Lukoil (LKOH.MM) , which controls the refinery, did not reply to a request for comment.
The plant, located 1,460 km (907 miles) northeast of Moscow, processed some 12.6 million tons, or 252,000 barrels per day, of oil in 2024.
It produced 2 million tons of gasoline, 5.3 million tons of diesel, 200,000 tons of fuel oil and 700,000 tons of petroleum coke.

items.title: Playoff paths of Padres, Pirates vastly changed over past month
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: If you want to know how much the fortunes of a baseball team can change in a month, look at the San Diego Padres.
items.body:
If you want to know how much the fortunes of a baseball team can change in a month, look at the San Diego Padres.
On July 23, after a loss to the Atlanta Braves, the Padres were 50-53. A month later, the Padres have a 63.6% chance of qualifying for the playoffs -- an increase of 54.3 percentage points, the highest in the major leagues, according to Baseball Reference. The team has a 21-7 record in that span, including an 8-1 rout of the Minnesota Twins on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
San Diego will try to improve its playoff odds a bit more on Monday night when it opens a three-game series with the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Padres (71-60) have a two-game lead over Arizona in the chase for the National League's final playoff spot. They also boast perhaps the hottest player in the majors, right fielder Fernando Tatis Jr.
His two home runs on Sunday gave him 12 since the All-Star break, tied with the Chicago Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong for the most in the majors, and 17 for the year. A 4-for-5, four-RBI day capped a week that saw him go 12-for-25 with four homers and 11 RBIs.
The player who didn't hit his first homer of the year until May 30 against the Washington Nationals suddenly can't be kept in the park.
"Maybe three months of struggling," Tatis said when asked what turned his season around. "No, I'm kidding, but man, just, baseball is a game of adjustments. So whoever's making the right adjustments right now is whoever (is) one step ahead."
Left-hander Robbie Ray (11-7, 3.20 ERA) will try to stay one step ahead of Pittsburgh on the mound on Monday. He's coming off a 5-2 win Tuesday at the New York Mets, yielding one run on three hits in six innings while walking three and striking out four. Ray is 3-2 with a 4.09 ERA in eight career starts against the Pirates.
Pittsburgh will counter with right-hander Braxton Ashcraft (13-5, 3.68 ERA), arguably its most consistent starter in 2026. He defeated the Detroit Tigers 4-1 on Tuesday, cruising through eight innings, allowing five hits and a run with no walks and four strikeouts. His only career outing against San Diego occurred June 1, 2025, when he struck out two in an inning out of the bullpen in a 6-4 loss.
The Pirates come to San Diego reeling from a three-game sweep by the Los Angeles Dodgers, including a 4-0 shutout in Sunday's series finale. The Pirates are 8 1/2 games behind the Padres in the race for the final wild-card spot. On July 23, Pittsburgh was 53-50 and one game out of the final wild-card spot. The Pirates have a 10-19 record since.
"I don't think getting swept is ever good," Pirates first baseman Spencer Horwitz said. "I think in our current situation, it definitely is bigger. This team has hopes for the playoffs, and it just got a whole lot harder."
Injuries to key contributors such as Ryan O'Hearn (quadriceps) and rookie shortstop Konnor Griffin (finger) have hurt. And aside from Ashcraft, pitching has been a problem. The team's ERA of 4.29 is 22nd in the majors.
San Diego won two of three games when the teams met in April at PNC Park. The Padres are 14-6 in the teams' past 20 matchups.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked ship off Saudi Arabia's Yanbu
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis attacked a vessel off Saudi Arabia’s port city of Yanbu in the Red Sea, the group's military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a televised speech on Monday.
items.body:
Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis attacked a vessel off Saudi Arabia’s port city of Yanbu in the Red Sea, the group's military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a televised speech on Monday.
Saudi Arabia's national shipping company Bahri later said one of its vessels, the "Amzan", was involved in a maritime incident in the Red Sea earlier in the day, adding that all crew members were safe and no injuries had been reported.
The company said it remained in contact with the vessel and was closely coordinating with the relevant authorities.
Earlier, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency said a tanker had been struck by an unknown projectile 63 nautical miles west of Yanbu.
The UKMTO said all crew were safe and accounted for with no reported environmental impact.
Yanbu is Saudi Arabia's main Red Sea oil port, where millions of barrels a day are loaded, and it has become the main route out for Saudi oil skirting the Strait of Hormuz, which has been blockaded by Iran.
Shipping from Yanbu has itself faced disruption since the Houthis declared a blockade on Saudi-linked vessels in the Red Sea last month.
The Houthis have [USN:S8N43I09N TEXT:"carried out other attacks"] on Saudi oil facilities and shipping in the Red Sea in recent weeks, and in July they claimed to have targeted Saudi oil giant Aramco facilities in Yanbu.

items.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq recuam enquanto tensões com o Irã testam mercados
items.author: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.creator: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.summary: O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq registravam queda nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os investidores avaliavam as possíveis repercussões da promessa dos Estados Unidos de um “Dia D econômico” contra o Irã, na expectativa dos resultados da gigante de IA Nvidia e de dados sobre a inflação nesta semana.
items.body:
O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq registravam queda nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os investidores avaliavam as possíveis repercussões da promessa dos Estados Unidos de um “Dia D econômico” contra o Irã, na expectativa dos resultados da gigante de IA Nvidia e de dados sobre a inflação nesta semana.
Esses movimentos marcam um início cauteloso para uma semana crucial, que poderá determinar se as ações conseguirão ignorar o recrudescimento das tensões no Oriente Médio e as preocupações relacionadas a um mercado de títulos tenso, fatores que interromperam seus ganhos.
Os EUA afirmaram que podem impor sanções econômicas contra os parceiros comerciais do Irã, no que chamaram de “a maior ofensiva financeira de todos os tempos”.
O secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, que alertou sobre um “Dia D econômico” em um artigo de opinião publicado no Financial Times, dará entrevista à imprensa à tarde.
Preocupações com o aumento dos preços da energia e a dívida pública galopante elevaram os rendimentos dos Treasuries na semana passada, com a taxa dos títulos de 30 anos atingindo a máxima em 19 anos antes de o Tesouro anunciar medidas de apoio.
Os rendimentos mais altos afetaram duramente as ações de tecnologia voltadas para o crescimento, fazendo com que os três principais índices de Wall Street registrassem perdas na semana passada.
A turbulência intensificou o foco no discurso do chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, no simpósio de Jackson Hole no final desta semana, onde os investidores analisarão minuciosamente suas declarações em busca de pistas sobre a interpretação das autoridades quanto aos esforços de resgate do Tesouro e aos dados econômicos mais recentes.
Os resultados trimestrais da Nvidia (NVDA.O) , a empresa mais valiosa do mundo, devem ser outro importante catalisador para os mercados. Qualquer sinal de desaceleração no crescimento pode reacender as preocupações com as valorizações elevadas e até onde a alta impulsionada pela inteligência artificial pode chegar.
As megacaps apresentavam resultados mistos nesta segunda-feira. Enquanto a Apple (AAPL.O) e a Amazon.com (AMZN.O) registravam ganhos de menos de 1% cada, a Nvidia perdia 2,44%.
O setor de Tecnologia da Informação do S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) , com queda de 1,11%, liderava as perdas setoriais. As ações do setor de saúde (.SPXHC) , uma aposta favorita para investidores que buscam diversificação além da IA, também caíam 0,57%.
O S&P 500 (.SPX) caía 0,27%, para 7.653,60 pontos. O Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha queda de 0,63%, a 26.015,94 pontos, enquanto o Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,21%, para 53.389,19 pontos.
Os mercados também acompanharão o relatório do índice de preços PCE, o indicador de inflação preferido do Fed, que será divulgado na quarta-feira, em busca de pistas sobre como o conflito com o Irã está afetando as condições econômicas mais amplas.
(Reportagem de Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant e Arasu Kannagi Basil em Bengaluru)

items.title: Trump menace d'imposer des droits de douane de 50% sur les véhicules produits au Canada
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Les droits de douane américains sur les voitures, les camions, les pièces détachées automobiles et l'acier produits au Canada seront portés à 50% à compter du 1er janvier 2027, a déclaré lundi Donald Trump dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux après l'échec des négociations commerciales avec Ottawa.
items.body:
Les droits de douane américains sur les voitures, les camions, les pièces détachées automobiles et l'acier produits au Canada seront portés à 50% à compter du 1er janvier 2027, a déclaré lundi Donald Trump dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux après l'échec des [USN:L8N44J00X TEXT:"négociations commerciales"] avec Ottawa.
"Fabriquez aux États-Unis et vous bénéficierez de ZÉRO DROITS DE DOUANE. Le Canada ne sera plus traité comme un État !", a écrit le président américain.
"En matière de commerce, mais aussi à bien d'autres égards, ils font partie des nations avec lesquelles il est le plus difficile de traiter au monde. Ils se croient tout permis, et pourtant, NOUS N'AVONS PAS BESOIN DU CANADA, C'EST EUX QUI ONT BESOIN DE NOUS !"
La Maison Blanche n'a pas immédiatement répondu à une demande de commentaire.
Les deux pays n'ont pas réussi à conclure un accord commercial vendredi soir, chacune des parties rejetant la responsabilité de cet échec sur l'autre.
Le Canada a annoncé dans la foulée qu'il allait imposer à compter du 8 septembre des droits de douane sur 25 milliards de dollars de produits américains en représailles aux droits de 50% ordonnés par Donald Trump sur un peu plus de 5% des exportations canadiennes vers les États-Unis.

items.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre en ordre dispersé, dans l'attente des sanctions contre l'Iran
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé lundi, les investisseurs optant pour la prudence en attendant les détails de nouvelles sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, en plus des résultats du géant de l'IA Nvidia plus tard dans la semaine.
items.body:
La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé lundi, les investisseurs optant pour la prudence en attendant les détails de nouvelles sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, en plus des résultats du géant de l'IA Nvidia plus tard dans la semaine.
Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 26,44 points, soit 0,05%, à 53.303,45 points tandis le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, recule de 0,23% à 7.656,58 points.
Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cède 0,50%, soit 130,23 points, à 26.050,23 points.
Une semaine décisive s'ouvre pour les marchés, alors que les États-Unis ont déclaré qu'ils pourraient mettre en place des sanctions économiques visant les partenaires commerciaux de l’Iran, dans le cadre de ce qu’ils ont qualifié de "plus grande offensive financière de tous les temps".
Le secrétaire au Trésor américain Scott Bessent doit tenir une conférence de presse à 17h00 GMT à ce sujet.
Tandis que les inquiétudes liées à la flambée des prix de l'énergie et à l'explosion de la dette publique ont pesé sur les rendements la semaine dernière, Scott Bessent pourrait puiser dans le compte général du Trésor, qui s'élève à près de 1.000 milliards de dollars, pour aider à financer les rachats d'obligations, au lieu d'émettre des bons du Trésor à court terme, a rapporté lundi CNBC, citant deux hauts responsables du Trésor.
Le rendement des bons du Trésor américain à 30 ans baisse légèrement, mais reste au-dessus du seuil des 5%.
Cette éventualité vient accroître l’attention portée au discours du président de la Réserve fédérale (Fed), Kevin Warsh, lors du symposium de Jackson Hole prévu plus tard cette semaine, où les investisseurs analyseront ses propos à la recherche d’indices sur l’interprétation par les décideurs politiques des efforts de sauvetage du Trésor et des dernières données économiques.
L'action Nvidia (NVDA.O) recule de 2,1%, alors que les résultats trimestriels de la société la plus valorisée au monde, prévus mercredi, devraient constituer un autre catalyseur clé pour les marchés, notamment ceux liés à l’intelligence artificielle (IA).
Les actions des producteurs américains d'acier et d'aluminium sont en hausse, après que Washington a annoncé samedi de l'imposition de droits de douane de 50% sur certains produits canadiens.
Nucor (NUE.N) , Steel Dynamics (STLD.O) et Century Aluminium (CENX.O) gagnent entre 3,9% et 5,5%, tandis que Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF.N) grimpe de 7,7%.

items.title: Tunisia’s cash holdings hit a record $10.5 billion, straining banks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cash holdings in Tunisia have risen by about 16% over the past year to a record 30 billion dinars ($10.5 billion), central bank data showed on Monday, as an increased reliance on physical money puts pressure on banks' liquidity.
items.body:
Cash holdings in Tunisia have risen by about 16% over the past year to a record 30 billion dinars ($10.5 billion), central bank data showed on Monday, as an increased reliance on physical money puts pressure on banks' liquidity.
Banknotes and coins in circulation reached 30.04 billion dinars as of August 21, up from 25.9 billion dinars a year earlier.
The increase means more money is being held outside bank accounts, potentially reducing the funds available to banks for lending to households and businesses.
Financial analysts say the rise has been in part fuelled by a new law introduced last year, which tightened rules for using bank cheques and raised penalties for bounced or invalid cheques.
The change has prompted businesses and individuals to withdraw more money for payments, further increasing the amount of cash in circulation and complicating liquidity management for banks.
Many Tunisians continue to prefer cash for everyday transactions due to the slow adoption of electronic payments and digital banking around the country, particularly outside of its large cities.

items.body:
Der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin hat die Behörden per Dekret ermächtigt, die Kontrolle über unzureichend geschützte kritische Infrastrukturen zu übernehmen. Damit reagiert Putin auf die zunehmenden ukrainischen Drohnenangriffe etwa auf Ölraffinerien und Logistikzentren. Die Regelung erlaubt es, Vermögenswerte sowie Eigentumsrechte unter vorübergehende staatliche Zwangsverwaltung zu stellen, wenn die Betreiber ihre Schutzpflichten verletzen oder Schäden nach Angriffen zu langsam beheben, hieß es in dem am Montag veröffentlichten Erlass.
Betroffen sind unter anderem Einrichtungen aus den Bereichen Energie, Industrie, Verkehr, Logistik und Kommunikation, die für die Sicherheit und wirtschaftliche Stabilität des Landes von zentraler Bedeutung sind. Die Ukraine hat zuletzt ihre Drohnenangriffe auf russische Ölraffinerien und Logistikzentren verstärkt. Unter anderem wurden seit dem 18. Juli mindestens 24 Lagerhallen des Online-Händlers Wildberries attackiert, wodurch erhebliche Kapazitäten ausfielen. Am Montag teilte zudem der zweitgrößte russische Online-Händler Ozon mit, dass vier seiner Logistikzentren im Süden Russlands Ziel ukrainischer Angriffe geworden seien.
Putin hatte die Regierung in der vergangenen Woche angewiesen, ein Wiederaufbauprogramm für beschädigte Gewerbe- und Lagerhallen aufzulegen. Vor allem die Attacken auf Raffinerien werden in Russland zunehmend zu einem Problem. Ein Mangel an Benzin und Diesel sorgt in der Bevölkerung für Unmut. An Tankstellen bilden sich vielerorts lange Schlangen, mitunter ist die Abgabe von Treibstoff bereits rationiert.

items.title: トランプ氏、対カナダ自動車・鉄鋼関税を50％に引き上げと表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、カナダから輸入する乗用車やトラック、自動車部品、鉄鋼に対する関税を５０％に引き上げると表明した。２０２７年１月１日に発効するとしている。  

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「米国で製造すれば関税はゼロだ」とした上で、「貿易面でもその他の面でも、カナダは世界で最も扱いにくい国の一つだ。彼らは当然の権利があるかのように振る舞うが、われわれはカナダを必要としていない。カナダこそが米国を必要としているのだ」と投稿した。

米国は２２日、カナダとの通商交渉が決裂したことを受け、約２００億ドル相当のカナダ製品に対する５０％の追加関税を発動した。ただ、対象はカナダの対米輸出額の５％強にとどまり、カナダ経済全体への影響は限定的との見方が出ている。

これに対し、カナダのカーニー首相は、９月８日から米国産の鉄鋼や電子機器などに関税を課す方針を表明した。

items.title: Norwegische Energiekonzerne suchen gemeinsam nach neuen Öl- und Gasvorkommen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die norwegischen Energiekonzerne Equinor, Aker BP und Vaar Energi bündeln ihre Kräfte, um in bislang weniger erforschten Gebieten des Landes nach großen Öl- und Gasvorkommen zu suchen. Die drei Unternehmen kündigten am Montag auf einer gemeinsamen Pressekonferenz an, in den kommenden vier bis fünf Jahren 20 bis 25 vielversprechende Projekte zu prüfen und jährlich etwa fünf aussichtsreiche Bohrungen vorzunehmen. Ab 2028 sollen sich die jährlichen Bohrkosten auf rund 750 Millionen Dollar belaufen, die zu gleichen Teilen aufgeteilt würden.
items.body:
Die norwegischen Energiekonzerne Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) und Vaar Energi (VAR.OL) bündeln ihre Kräfte, um in bislang weniger erforschten Gebieten des Landes nach großen Öl- und Gasvorkommen zu suchen. Die drei Unternehmen kündigten am Montag auf einer gemeinsamen Pressekonferenz an, in den kommenden vier bis fünf Jahren 20 bis 25 vielversprechende Projekte zu prüfen und jährlich etwa fünf aussichtsreiche Bohrungen vorzunehmen. Ab 2028 sollen sich die jährlichen Bohrkosten auf rund 750 Millionen Dollar belaufen, die zu gleichen Teilen aufgeteilt würden.
"Durch die Bündelung unserer Kräfte verbessern wir das Explorationsportfolio und senken gleichzeitig das Risiko", erklärte der Chef des Norwegen-Geschäfts von Equinor, Kjetil Hove. Die ersten Bohrungen sollen ihm zufolge vor allem in der Region Haltenbanken in der Norwegischen See stattfinden.
In den vergangenen Jahren konzentrierten sich die Bohrungen in Norwegen meist auf Gebiete rund um bestehende Öl- und Gasfelder. Dies führte zu kleineren Funden, die schnell in die Produktion überführt werden konnten. "Die feldnahe Exploration bleibt von entscheidender Bedeutung, aber wir müssen auch größere Möglichkeiten verfolgen, um die Aktivität und Wertschöpfung über das Jahr 2035 hinaus aufrechtzuerhalten", sagte Hove. Norwegen ist der größte Öl- und Gasproduzent Europas. Die Regierung bestärkt Energieunternehmen trotz Bedenken von Umweltschützern darin, nach neuen Vorkommen zu suchen, um den Fortbestand der heimischen Erdölindustrie um Jahrzehnte zu verlängern.

items.title: Monitor de safras da UE reduz novamente previsão para milho devido à seca
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O serviço de monitoramento de culturas Mars reduziu, nesta segunda-feira, pelo segundo mês consecutivo, sua previsão para a produtividade do milho semeado neste ano na União Europeia, após o calor e a seca continuarem a prejudicar as plantações.
items.body:
O serviço de monitoramento de culturas Mars reduziu, nesta segunda-feira, pelo segundo mês consecutivo, sua previsão para a produtividade do milho semeado neste ano na União Europeia, após o calor e a seca continuarem a prejudicar as plantações.
A previsão aponta para um rendimento médio do milho na próxima safra da UE de 6,61 toneladas métricas por hectare (t/ha), abaixo das 6,93 t/ha projetadas em julho e das 7,38 t/ha em junho.
A revisão mais recente colocou a produtividade projetada na UE 7% abaixo da média de cinco anos, informou o Mars em um relatório sobre as culturas.
As culturas de verão, como o milho, foram gravemente afetadas por temperaturas recordes e seca intensa em algumas regiões da Europa.
"Os impactos variam de reduções moderadas no rendimento a perdas graves, com provável perda total da safra nas regiões mais afetadas", afirmou o Mars sobre a situação das culturas de verão na Europa Ocidental e Central.
Entre outras culturas de verão, o Mars reduziu sua previsão para o rendimento da beterraba sacarina da UE de 76,0 t/ha para 72,2 t/ha, agora 5% abaixo da média de cinco anos.
Para as oleaginosas de verão, a projeção de produtividade das sementes de girassol foi reduzida de 1,94 t/ha para 1,92 t/ha, 3% abaixo da média de cinco anos, e a previsão para a soja foi reduzida de 2,62 t/ha para 2,31 t/ha, 14% abaixo da média de cinco anos.
As condições climáticas adversas também afetaram as pastagens, gerando preocupações quanto ao abastecimento de forragem para a pecuária, informou o Mars.
(Reportagem de Gus Trompiz)
